cues.name: launch
cues.text: One playful ink bubble swelling with a soft rubber creak, dry short game interface cue, no voice, no music, gentle attack.

cues.name: go
cues.text: One crisp cheerful two-note rising wooden pop, unmistakable arcade start signal, dry, no voice, no reverb, soft attack.

cues.name: lunge
cues.text: One short elastic rubber snap into a silky wet whoosh, playful blob darting forward, dry cartoon movement, no voice, no music, no harsh click.

cues.name: eat
cues.text: One tiny satisfying rounded ink droplet plop, soft and warm, dry minimal arcade pickup sound, no voice, no music, no extra tail.

cues.name: warning
cues.text: One clear short hollow double woodblock warning pulse, concerned but friendly, gentle dry arcade alert, no siren, no voice, no music.

cues.name: respawn
cues.text: One comic soft bubble pop followed by a small liquid wobble, ink blob reforming, gentle and playful, dry, no voice, no music.

cues.name: finish
cues.text: One triumphant rubber stamp impact followed by two warm short brass-like notes, tiny playful arcade finish flourish, no voice, no long reverb.
